authority.source: Owner decision 2026-10-24: the definitions are confirmed as written. They were recovered from the generated-interface design and its first milestone checks; no source is bound to the model yet.

scope: Owner-confirmed definitions: recorded interface commits of the generated inventory-reservation interface.

trace.source_revision: proposed generated-interface model; no source is bound yet
trace.event_schema: interface-commit/1: presentation state, focus, open dialog and route exposure before and after each commit
trace.order: authoritative order of recorded interface commits, including opening a dialog and changing focus
trace.projection: retain each recorded event without sorting, merging or deduplication
trace.model: proposed: the generated presentation core of the inventory-reservation interface; execution membership is unproved until that model is bound
trace.environment: proposed: any user navigation, inferred hints and preference changes (width, theme, motion); hints may change emphasis only
trace.initialization: the initial view is checked separately: every declared region has data, empty or loading status
trace.transitions: requires exact membership in the generated presentation core
trace.continuity: requires post/pre correspondence of focus, dialog and exposure at every retained commit

Required.definition: Owner-confirmed. The action is a command route of the contract (reserve, release, ship or restock): every command variant is a required task at every event, independently of what the interface shows. Busy or uncertain states may prevent invocation, not inspection.

VisualRoute.definition: Owner-confirmed. A named control for the action is visible and reachable from the current focus within h=2 navigation actions by pointer or keyboard, honouring the open dialog: leave the dialog, then choose the task in the persistent task navigation. Moving focus inside one region is not counted.

AssistiveRoute.definition: Owner-confirmed. The same control is in the accessibility tree with its accessible name and reachable within h=2 keyboard navigation actions; hidden or inert elements cannot receive focus. Actual browser and screen-reader exposure is separate browser evidence.

readings.body: forall sigma in Traces: forall a in Actions: always(Required(a) => Discoverable(a))
readings.intuitive: every required action remains discoverable at every recorded UI event

fixtures.note: Opening the review dialog at event 1 keeps every task within two navigation actions: leave the dialog, choose the task.
A dialog without a leave route hides the reserve task at event 1.
The ship control is in the accessibility tree but has no visual route: discoverability needs both modes.
Vacuous implication; under the proposed Required every command route is required, so a real interface never shows this word.
